preceding_paragraph: b, Performance on represented-location queries (G1) and unseen-location queries (G2), with no additional template deletion (H0). Values are arithmetic means ± sample standard deviations across 15 randomized corpus/query-location draws; the variance estimate uses a denominator of 14. All designs share the same query locations and perturbation vector within each group and draw. The vector has Gaussian components with standard deviation 0.02 m and is reused across all queries in that draw. Each group contains 180 queries per draw (20 locations × three magnitudes × three demand states). MRR@5 is reciprocal rank truncated at five distinct partitions and averaged over the queries, reported on a 0–1 scale. The distance endpoint is the within-draw median Euclidean separation between the highest-ranked template location and the true leak location, in network-coordinate units; its arithmetic mean and sample s.d. across draws are reported here. Supplementary Fig. S1 presents the same means ± sample s.d. as bars with error caps, with the 15 individual draws overlaid as points.
